sources.title: Swin Transformer · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Swin Transformer is a hierarchical vision transformer. Images are processed in patches and windowed self-attention is used to capture local information. These windows are shifted across the image to allow for cross-window connections, capturing global information more efficiently.
